additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480558-DC/Si-D/DE-[RVP/T2170004474] Connection to DepotFinity closed CRM:03056001072
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0480558.
I checked the logs of the disconnection events on 23rd February, and these are my findings:
The OCPP connection was first lost at 2026-02-23T07:00:28 with reason: "Connection closed because of missing Pong from server."
A new connection to the server was established at 2026-02-23T07:04:02, but it went offline again at 2026-02-23T07:04:58 with the same reason.
Another symptom we saw is "OCPP-Central-System connection error: Unexpected server response: 404"
Charger remained offline until 2026-02-23T09:52:28., when it suddenly managed to open a new connection to the Backend.
Charger went offline on OCPP at 2026-02-23T10:10:28, always for missing pong from server.
After this, a reboot was performed onsite a2026-02-23T14:28:54, and when the charger booted up, it went online on DepotFinity.
From my understanding, it seems that DepotFinity was closing the channel with the charger. However, the logs do not say more than the messages I reported to you.
I will open a Jira Ticket to DepotFinity to ask for clarifications. I will get back to you in the next days as soon as I have feedback.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer

Thank you.
